index.title: API tokens
index.description: Personal access tokens let scripts and tools call the API as you, limited to the scopes you choose.
index.usage: Send a token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <token>.

admin.title: API tokens
admin.description: Every personal access token and service key in this organisation.
admin.tenant_required: Choose an organisation to see and create its API tokens.

list.name: Name
list.empty_description: Create a token to call the API from a script or another service.

form.create_description: The token can do only what its scopes allow, and never more than you can.
form.create_service_description: A service key acts for no person. It gets the roles you pick, limited to the scopes you choose.
form.name: Name
form.scopes_hint: Only permissions you hold are listed.
form.roles_hint: The administrator role cannot be given to a service key.

created.title: Copy your new token
created.warning: This is the only time the token is shown. Store it somewhere safe now — it cannot be recovered.

revoke.title: Revoke "{name}"?
revoke.description: Anything using this token stops working on its next request. This cannot be undone.

toasts.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

revoke_all.title: Revoke all your tokens?
revoke_all.description: Every personal access token you hold stops working on its next request, in every organisation. Use this if a token may have leaked: changing your password or signing out everywhere does not end tokens.
